info.name: Atahad API
info.description:
# Atahad · أتعهّد API

**Keep your promise, or a charity wins. Either way, good is done.**

Atahad is a commitment app: a member promises a habit or a goal and puts money on it, proves every time with a photo, timer, quiz, location or steps, and an AI checks the proof. A missed time without an accepted excuse becomes a donation to Ehsan, and the app stays locked until it is paid. Members can also commit together in groups.

This collection documents all **193 endpoints** of the Spring Boot backend, grouped by the four parts of the team.

| Part | Owner | Endpoints |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · Core & Users | Abdulelah Alwadani | 45 |
| 2 · Proofs, Excuses & Donations | Subhiyyah Alkhedher | 57 |
| 3 · Commitments | Turki Alghamdi | 45 |
| 4 · Groups | Fai Alharthi | 46 |

## Base URL

`{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:8080` when running locally. Every path starts with `/api/v1`.

## Authentication

HTTP **Basic** auth with the account's email and password. Set the collection variables `email` and `password`, and every request uses them.

Public endpoints (no login): `POST /member/register` and the Google OAuth callback. The `/n8n` endpoints are called by the n8n workflows and use the `X-N8N-KEY` header instead of a login (collection variable `n8nKey`).

## Roles

| Role | Can do |
|---|---|
| **Member** | Everything about their own commitments, proofs, excuses, donations and groups |
| **Admin** | Review queue, members, penalties, proof methods, and the admin lists |

Each request shows its **Access** line. Ids in the path such as `{memberId}` or `{adminId}` must be the logged-in user's own id; ownership of other ids (a week, a group) is checked in the service.

## The account lock

| State | What the member can do |
|---|---|
| `ACTIVE` | Everything |
| `LOCKED` | Has an unpaid penalty: only donate, send an excuse, or object |
| `BANNED` | Refused a group donation 3 times: only pay what is owed |
| `DEACTIVATED` | Nothing |

The lock is calculated from the data on every request; it is never set by hand.

## Responses and errors

Successful calls return the resource as JSON, or `{"message": "..."}` for actions.
Errors always look like this:

```json
{ "message": "Objection not found" }
```

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | A business rule or validation failed (the message says which) |
| `401` | Not logged in, or a wrong email/password |
| `403` | Logged in, but this role cannot call the endpoint |

## The week

A week runs **Sunday to Saturday**. Proofs and excuses count until Saturday 23:59:59 (Asia/Riyadh). Every day at 00:00 n8n calls `POST /n8n/run-daily`, which closes the finished weeks, makes the penalties, and runs the group settlements.

🤖 marks the endpoints that use AI (Google Gemini and OpenRouter, each with fallback models).
